import re,zlib,struct,math,sys
lines=open('text.gcode').read().splitlines()
a,b=15013,98472

def png_write(path,w,h,pix):
    # pix bytearray RGB rows
    raw=b''.join(b'\x00'+bytes(pix[y*w*3:(y+1)*w*3]) for y in range(h))
    def chunk(t,d):
        c=struct.pack('>I',len(d))+t+d
        return c+struct.pack('>I',zlib.crc32(t+d)&0xffffffff)
    hdr=struct.pack('>IIBBBBB',w,h,8,2,0,0,0)
    open(path,'wb').write(b'\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n'+chunk(b'IHDR',hdr)+chunk(b'IDAT',zlib.compress(raw,6))+chunk(b'IEND',b''))

def render(segs, path, W=1600, H=800, pad=20, color_by_z=False, zmin=0,zmax=65, bbox=None):
    if bbox is None:
        xs=[p[0] for s in segs for p in s]; ys=[p[1] for s in segs for p in s]
        minx,maxx=min(xs),max(xs); miny,maxy=min(ys),max(ys)
    else: minx,maxx,miny,maxy=bbox
    sx=(W-2*pad)/(maxx-minx); sy=(H-2*pad)/(maxy-miny); s=min(sx,sy)
    def tx(x): return pad+(x-minx)*s
    def ty(y): return H-pad-(y-miny)*s
    pix=bytearray([255])*(W*H*3)
    def put(x,y,c):
        if 0<=x<W and 0<=y<H:
            i=(y*W+x)*3; pix[i:i+3]=bytes(c)
    def line(x0,y0,x1,y1,c):
        x0,y0,x1,y1=tx(x0),ty(y0),tx(x1),ty(y1)
        dx=abs(x1-x0); dy=abs(y1-y0); n=int(max(dx,dy))
        if n==0: put(int(x0),int(y0),c); return
        for i in range(n+1):
            t=i/n; put(int(x0+(x1-x0)*t+.5),int(y0+(y1-y0)*t+.5),c)
    if color_by_z:
        import colorsys
        for (x0,y0,z0),(x1,y1,z1) in segs:
            hh=(z0-zmin)/(zmax-zmin)*0.8
            r,g,bb=colorsys.hsv_to_rgb(hh,0.9,0.8)
            line(x0,y0,x1,y1,(int(r*255),int(g*255),int(bb*255)))
    else:
        for (x0,y0,z0),(x1,y1,z1) in segs:
            line(x0,y0,x1,y1,(0,0,0))
    png_write(path,W,H,pix)

  # sample endpoints to reduce
  pts.append((x,y,z));pts.append((nx,ny,nz))

n=len(pts)

cov=[[0.0]*3 for _ in range(3)]
for x,y,z in pts:
 d=(x-cx,y-cy,z-cz)
 for i in range(3):
  for j in range(3):cov[i][j]+=d[i]*d[j]/n

  A[p][k]=c*apk-s*aqk;A[q][k]=s*apk+c*aqk

  vkp=V[k][p];vkq=V[k][q]

import re,math,collections,sys
lines=open('text.gcode').read().splitlines();a,b=15013,98472
pts=[];x=y=z=None
for i in range(a,b):
 l=lines[i]
 if not l.startswith('G1'): continue
 mx=re.search(r'X([-+]?\d*\.?\d+)',l); my=re.search(r'Y([-+]?\d*\.?\d+)',l); mz=re.search(r' Z([-+]?\d*\.?\d+)',l)
 me=re.search(r'E([-+]?\d*\.?\d+)',l)
 nx=float(mx.group(1)) if mx else x; ny=float(my.group(1)) if my else y; nz=float(mz.group(1)) if mz else z
 if me and float(me.group(1))>0 and x is not None:pts.append((x,y,z,nx,ny,nz))
 x,y,z=nx,ny,nz
c=(126.12079211713414,110.7931071671581,30.6846268995237)
e2=(0.4029731907464937,-0.912531027457639,-0.0699980818786891)
e3=(0.8668523813194575,0.3560295916103413,0.34901272025323005)
def dot(p,e):return (p[0]-c[0])*e[0]+(p[1]-c[1])*e[1]+(p[2]-c[2])*e[2]
segs=[(dot(p[:3],e3),dot(p[:3],e2),dot(p[3:],e3),dot(p[3:],e2)) for p in pts]
minx=min(min(s[0],s[2]) for s in segs);maxx=max(max(s[0],s[2]) for s in segs)
miny=min(min(s[1],s[3]) for s in segs);maxy=max(max(s[1],s[3]) for s in segs)
scale=10 # px per mm
W=int((maxx-minx)*scale)+5;H=int((maxy-miny)*scale)+5
g=[bytearray(W) for _ in range(H)]
def put(ix,iy):
 if 0<=ix<W and 0<=iy<H:g[iy][ix]=1
for x0,y0,x1,y1 in segs:
 X0=(x0-minx)*scale+2;Y0=(y0-miny)*scale+2;X1=(x1-minx)*scale+2;Y1=(y1-miny)*scale+2
 n=int(max(abs(X1-X0),abs(Y1-Y0))*2)+1
 for i in range(n+1):
  t=i/n;put(round(X0+(X1-X0)*t),round(Y0+(Y1-Y0)*t))
print('raster',W,H,'bbox',minx,maxx,miny,maxy)
# connected components 8-neigh
comp=[[-1]*W for _ in range(H)]; comps=[]
for yy in range(H):
 for xx in range(W):
  if g[yy][xx] and comp[yy][xx]<0:
   idx=len(comps);q=[(xx,yy)];comp[yy][xx]=idx;cells=[]
   while q:
    x0,y0=q.pop();cells.append((x0,y0))
    for dy in (-1,0,1):
     for dx in (-1,0,1):
      if dx==0 and dy==0:continue
      nx=x0+dx;ny=y0+dy
      if 0<=nx<W and 0<=ny<H and g[ny][nx] and comp[ny][nx]<0:
       comp[ny][nx]=idx;q.append((nx,ny))
   comps.append(cells)
print('components',len(comps))
info=[]
for i,cells in enumerate(comps):
 xs=[p[0] for p in cells];ys=[p[1] for p in cells]
 if len(cells)>10:
  info.append((min(xs),max(xs),min(ys),max(ys),len(cells),i))
info.sort()
for a0,a1,b0,b1,n,i in info:
 print(f'comp {i}: x {minx+a0/scale:.1f}-{minx+a1/scale:.1f} y {miny+b0/scale:.1f}-{miny+b1/scale:.1f} w {(a1-a0)/scale:.1f} h {(b1-b0)/scale:.1f} n{n}')

import re,math
from PIL import Image,ImageDraw,ImageOps,ImageFilter
lines=open('text.gcode').read().splitlines();a,b=15013,98472
pts=[];x=y=z=None
for i in range(a,b):
 l=lines[i]
 if not l.startswith('G1'): continue
 mx=re.search(r'X([-+]?\d*\.?\d+)',l); my=re.search(r'Y([-+]?\d*\.?\d+)',l); mz=re.search(r' Z([-+]?\d*\.?\d+)',l)
 me=re.search(r'E([-+]?\d*\.?\d+)',l)
 nx=float(mx.group(1)) if mx else x; ny=float(my.group(1)) if my else y; nz=float(mz.group(1)) if mz else z
 if me and float(me.group(1))>0 and x is not None:pts.append((x,y,z,nx,ny,nz))
 x,y,z=nx,ny,nz
c=(126.12079211713414,110.7931071671581,30.6846268995237)
e1=(-0.2935635477036887,-0.20132077345589353,0.9345000747109359)
e2=(0.4029731907464937,-0.912531027457639,-0.0699980818786891)
e3=(0.8668523813194575,0.3560295916103413,0.34901272025323005)
def dot(p,e):return (p[0]-c[0])*e[0]+(p[1]-c[1])*e[1]+(p[2]-c[2])*e[2]
def make(axis_h,axis_v,flip_h=False,flip_v=False,fn='out.png',scale=30,width=3):
 segs=[]
 for p in pts:
  h0=dot(p[:3],axis_h);v0=dot(p[:3],axis_v);h1=dot(p[3:],axis_h);v1=dot(p[3:],axis_v)
  segs.append((h0,v0,h1,v1))
 minx=min(min(s[0],s[2]) for s in segs);maxx=max(max(s[0],s[2]) for s in segs)
 miny=min(min(s[1],s[3]) for s in segs);maxy=max(max(s[1],s[3]) for s in segs)
 W=int((maxx-minx)*scale)+100;H=int((maxy-miny)*scale)+100
 im=Image.new('L',(W,H),255);d=ImageDraw.Draw(im)
 def tx(x):return 50+(x-minx)*scale
 def ty(y):return H-50-(y-miny)*scale
 for x0,y0,x1,y1 in segs:
  d.line((tx(x0),ty(y0),tx(x1),ty(y1)),fill=0,width=width)
 if flip_h:im=ImageOps.mirror(im)
 if flip_v:im=ImageOps.flip(im)
 im.save(fn)
 return im
for label,h,v in [('e3_e2',e3,e2),('e2_e3',e2,e3),('e3_ne2',e3,tuple(-q for q in e2)),('ne3_e2',tuple(-q for q in e3),e2)]:
 for fh in (False,True):

   fn=f'/app/ocr_{label}_{int(fh)}{int(fv)}.png'
   im=make(h,v,fh,fv,fn)
   print(fn,im.size)
